text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer understand patterns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. Good training data usually leads to more accurate predictions, so choosing the right data is very important.
